cases.Subject: ARITZIA - Requesting alerting for Kafka message failures
cases.subject: ARITZIA - Requesting alerting for Kafka message failures
cases.Description:
Hi GO Team,
Following last week's Kafka issues between Grey Matter and Robotics Hub, I'd like to formally submit a request to track what was already discussed verbally with @Crystal Welker<mailto:crystal.w@greyorange.com>.

  1.
Alerting for failed messages - We'd like GO to add alerts that notify Aritzia when a message fails to reach Robotics Hub after all resend attempts.
  2.
Resend timing options - We'd also like to understand what options are available for the timing of message resends. Is it possible to configure resends at different intervals? For example:

  *   1st resend: within 15 seconds
  *   2nd and 3rd resends: 1–2 minutes after the 1st attempt

Could you please confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for these requests?
Thank you,
Matthew Teasdale
Director, Solution Delivery, Distribution Technology
ARITZIA
415 Boyne St
New Westminster, BC  V3M 5K2

cases.Subject: GTPN Saas - Audits Automatically Changing to FAILED or CANCELLED
cases.subject: GTPN Saas - Audits Automatically Changing to FAILED or CANCELLED
cases.Description:
Hi team,

We are experiencing an issue in GTPN SaaS. Many audits are being created, but when we try to start them, the system immediately changes their status to FAILED. We have attached a video showing the issue.

We previously created a support case, and the reported reason was that the audits had been manually canceled. However, this is incorrect. After some time, the system automatically changes their status to CANCELLED.

We need your help investigating this issue as soon as possible, as it is preventing us from performing audits.

Best regards,

cases.Subject: SAMSATL TTP Bot 28 has updated vda giving Stretch Push Error and causing Tote Mismatch
cases.subject: SAMSATL TTP Bot 28 has updated vda giving Stretch Push Error and causing Tote Mismatch
cases.Description:
Hello team,

Bot 28 had one tote in the fork and 7 totes in the tray. We recovered the
bot by removing one tote from the tray. After unloading some totes, the bot
got the stretch push error again.

Tote A000013626 was in the fork and showing at TLOC_0019435, but a
different tote, A000013806, was present at that location and was unassigned.

Bot 28 is already updated to the latest VDA version, but the issue is still
happening.

Can you please check and fix the issue? It is causing tote mismatches.
Thank you

cases.Subject: Projector Issue @DHL FIGS
cases.subject: Projector Issue @DHL FIGS
cases.Description:
Hello GreyOrange,

Site: DHL FIGS

Issue: Projector issues on three stations

Please see the details below:

  - PPS 16: The projector is not pointing at the correct MSU slot and
vibrates significantly while projecting the beam.

  - PPS 11: The projector is not pointing at the correct MSU slot.


Support Required : We need the Remote Hardware team to work with the onsite
team to attempt projector calibration for PPS 16 and PPS 11.


 PPS 35: The projector moves, but there is no light. (No action required;
we will replace it.)

Warm regards,
Kunal Gaurav

cases.subject: Update velocity_profile_map for butlersafetyranger3 || Sam's ATL
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

Please create an SR ticket and assign it to the TAC team for the following
configuration update.

*Request:* On the server, update the velocity_profile_map in the butler_type
configuration for butlersafetyranger3 from profile_type_Ninja to
profile_type_Ninja_1_2_new.

*Current configuration:*

{butlersafetyranger3,
    [{butler_speed,profile_type_Ninja},
     {velocity_profile_map,profile_type_Ninja},
     {butler_turn_time,butler_turn_time_ninja_1_2},
     {butler_dimensions,butler_dimensions_Ninja},
     {rack_turn_distance,rack_turn_distance_01},
     {butler_allowed_movement,butler_allowed_movement_02},
     {independent_rack_turn,independent_rack_turn_03},
     {bi_directional_movement,bi_directional_movement_04},
     {grid_attribute_cost,grid_attribute_cost_01},
     {use_lane_count_multiplier,false}]}

*Required configuration:*

{butlersafetyranger3,
    [{butler_speed,profile_type_Ninja},
     {velocity_profile_map,profile_type_Ninja_1_2_new},
     {butler_turn_time,butler_turn_time_ninja_1_2},
     {butler_dimensions,butler_dimensions_Ninja},
     {rack_turn_distance,rack_turn_distance_01},
     {butler_allowed_movement,butler_allowed_movement_02},
     {independent_rack_turn,independent_rack_turn_03},
     {bi_directional_movement,bi_directional_movement_04},
     {grid_attribute_cost,grid_attribute_cost_01},
     {use_lane_count_multiplier,false}]}

Please ensure that only the velocity_profile_map value is changed and all
other settings remain unchanged.


*Regards,*

*Lakshit Tyagi*

*Assistant Manager**  - Global Hardware Support*

*Grey**Orange* *India (P) Ltd.* | www.greyorange.com

cases.Subject: RyderML Issue  : Barcode Item Master Update Failing When Inventory Exists
cases.subject: RyderML Issue  : Barcode Item Master Update Failing When Inventory Exists
cases.Description:
Hi GreyOrange Support Team,
We’ve identified an instance of Item Master message  failure from SCALE to GM with:
ERR002 – Qty, hierarchy or barcode updation of Item is not allowed as it exists in inventory
Sample data: Item 3E5F8AA, new barcode 555888495. (in STG Env, and W3T08A in PRD)
We understand restricting case quantity (hierarchy changes) when inventory exists. However, adding a new barcode should not be blocked with this error/ reason, since vendors do introduce new barcodes for their SKUs while inventory for the existing item is still on hand in the warehouse or in stores.
Operationally, users cannot just remove and re-induct all existing inventory each time a new supplier barcode is introduced. The new barcode should be able to flow through ERP → SCALE → GM as an Item Master attribute without impacting the existing inventory levels.
Please review why barcode additions are subject to this restriction and advise on next steps to allow new barcodes updates .
Thanks,
Hassan

cases.Subject: Bot-50 is loading a tote in tray where already another tote
cases.subject: Bot-50 is loading a tote in tray where already another tote
cases.Description:
Hi GreyOrange
Please assign this ticket to TAC to analyze this case: Bot 50 has 2 totes
in its tray and 1 tote in its fork. The bot is trying to place a tote on
Tray 7, but a tote is physically present on Tray 7 that is not showing in
the system.
*Below are the tote IDs: *
Tray 7 - 22292
Tray 6 - 14147
Fork - 4303
*Analysis from Harware team as per them issue with GMC*
* ncomplete load list. GMC’s updateLoadStatus listed 5 of 7 totes.
* No verification. The VDA applied the list without scanning, so trays 6
and 7 stayed unknown.
* Unloads emptied the list. After the five unloads the VDA showed No load,
so GMC treated the bot as empty.
* Collision. GMC assigned TRAY_7; the VDA sent the move with no occupancy
check, and the bot stopped on the occupied tray.
* Early FINISHED. The VDA reported toteLoad done on the ack, so GMC fired
the next order while the bot was mid-move.
-- 
Thanks and Regards,

Ramesh chander
GreyOrange India (P) Ltd.

Contact:+14709672793

cases.Description:
Hello GO Team,
We understand that the current setup for the PPTL lights at the Put Station displays the item count for a tote only when an associate scans that tote for put-away.
However, each roll cage contains 8 totes, and the remaining totes show a count of zero until they are individually scanned.
Our request is to determine whether it is possible for the PPTL system to display the item counts for all totes on the roll cage as soon as the roll cage is inducted into the Put PPS Station, rather than requiring each tote to be scanned individually.
Could you please let us know if this functionality is possible?

cases.Subject: HMSS - Induct 1 could not be reset - Issue Reoccurred
cases.subject: HMSS - Induct 1 could not be reset - Issue Reoccurred
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

We are experiencing the same issue again with Induct 1, where the induct station cannot be reset.

For reference, a similar issue was previously reported under GO Case #00300649 (Ajax site hardware HMTASKID#996), which was subsequently closed after the issue was resolved.

The current behavior appears to be the same as the previous occurrence. We have attempted the basic troubleshooting steps; however, the issue persists.

Could you please:

Review the previous case #00300649 and provide details on what was identified as the root cause at that time?
Advise if there is any workaround that we can perform while the issue is being investigated.
Help us understand what may be causing this issue and whether there are any checks or corrective actions that can be performed from our side to prevent recurrence.

Please include any recommendations or preventive actions that the site team can take if this is a known issue.

Reference Case: 00300649

Thank you.

cases.Description:
Supply Chain Ticket
Location SIC:
CL1

High

All
Affected Application (GO, WMx, BAx, SMART, KRONOS)
GO

ALL
Operational Impact
HIGH
Business Impact
HIGH
Problem Summary: Request to remove the automatic bar code blocking feature.

cases.Subject: URGENT – Incorrect Bin Light Configuration | Tickets 00295182 & 00299832
cases.subject: URGENT – Incorrect Bin Light Configuration | Tickets 00295182 & 00299832
cases.Description:
Hi @Grey Orange - Chetanay Ahuja<mailto:chetanay.a@greyorange.com>

This is an urgent SOS request regarding the bin-light configuration change completed under ticket 00295182.

The original request was to correct the Pick PPTL light colours for the 200-series BACK bins. However, the configuration was applied to the 100-series FRONT bins, causing the Front-bin lights to display incorrect colours and creating operational issues.

Ticket 00299832 has been opened for the incorrect 100-series front-bin lights.
Please treat this as high priority and urgently:

  *   Revert the configuration changes made to the 100-series FRONT bins.
  *   Apply the correct packing-colour configuration to the 200-series BACK bins:
     *   PACK_BAG_LARGE: Yellow
     *   PACK_BAG_SMALL: White
     *   CARTON_BUILD: Purple
     *   PACK_MANUAL: Green
     *   GTP_PICK_CHASE: Red
     *
This incorrect configuration is currently causing issues for the operation, so an immediate correction is required.

Thank you!

Adeena Khan
Operations TLA, FC2028
E adeena.khan@walmart.com
C 403.355.0801 - 68542
[cid:image001.png@01DD66E2.E57735E0]

cases.Subject: HMSS - SEV 2 - Inventory Attributes and Owner Tags Missing for 95 SKUs
cases.subject: HMSS - SEV 2 - Inventory Attributes and Owner Tags Missing for 95 SKUs
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

We are currently experiencing a large-scale recurrence of the known issue where inventory records in MD > Inventory > GTP Listing are missing the expected Attributes and Owner Tags. As a result, impacted inventory is only showing the system storage tag, leading to sort pick exceptions and inventory integrity concerns.

This issue was previously reported under GO Case #00298331 and is related to the known defect previously investigated under GO Case #00295094, where positive adjustments/audit activities caused inventory attributes and owner tags to be removed from inventory records.

The issue has now expanded significantly and is currently impacting 95 unique SKUs across multiple locations.

Observed Behavior:

Attributes section is blank in GTP Listing.
Owner tag is missing from inventory records.
Inventory only displays the system storage tag.
Inventory becomes eligible for incorrect sort-pick behavior.
Operations team continues to identify additional affected SKUs.

Reference Tickets:

GO Case #00298331

Request:

Please investigate whether the affected SKUs are experiencing the same known issue.
Confirm if the previous hotfix has failed or if a new defect is causing inventory attributes to be removed.
Perform the required script/workaround to restore attributes and owner tags for the impacted inventory.
Provide RCA and permanent fix timeline as the issue continues to reoccur despite previous remediation.
Escalate to Product/Engineering team for urgent review.

cases.Subject: Concerns Regarding System Performance and Potential Impact from Global GreyOrange Infrastructure Load
cases.subject: Concerns Regarding System Performance and Potential Impact from Global GreyOrange Infrastructure Load
cases.Description:
Dear GreyOrange Support Team,

We have repeatedly experienced periods of reduced system performance and slow data communication within our GreyOrange installation.

These issues are most noticeable during Black Friday and other peak operational periods, but they also occur at various times throughout the year.

As GreyOrange operates a global platform supporting many customers worldwide, we would like to better understand whether fluctuations in performance could be related to shared infrastructure resources and prioritization of capacity across the customer base.

Specifically, we would like to understand whether customers with significantly larger installations or higher transaction volumes could influence the availability of centralized resources, potentially resulting in reduced performance for smaller installations such as ours during periods of exceptionally high demand.

Some of the challenges we have observed include:


  *   Increased response times across the system.
  *   Delays in communication between system components.
  *   Timeouts and task execution failures.
  *   General degradation of system performance during peak operational periods.

Given the substantial increase in activity that occurs globally during events such as Black Friday, we would appreciate clarification on whether any centralized services, cloud infrastructure, databases, message brokers, API gateways, monitoring systems, or other shared GreyOrange resources could become constrained and consequently affect customer site performance.

In particular, we would appreciate your input on the following:


  1.  Which components of the GreyOrange platform rely on centralized or cloud-based services.
  2.  Whether overall global platform utilization can impact the performance experienced at individual customer sites.
  3.  How GreyOrange manages capacity allocation and prioritization during periods of exceptionally high system load.
  4.  Whether larger customers with higher transaction vol...

The PPTL on PS3 Front No. 16 has been replaced with a new unit, as the previous PPTL was defective.

cases.Subject: Site 5976 | Preventive Monitoring for Atlas → GO Release and RCA Confirmation – Oct 25th and 26th
cases.subject: Site 5976 | Preventive Monitoring for Atlas → GO Release and RCA Confirmation – Oct 25th and 26th
cases.Description:
Hi team,
I would like to request your support in maintaining network and application monitoring for Site 5976 starting at 3:00 PM today.
As part of our operational strategy, orders in the all GTP process path with ATR status will remain in the Atlas backlog to build order density and will be released tomorrow (Oct 26th) at 6:00 AM.
Additionally, during today’s 6:00 AM Atlas release, we experienced performance degradation in the migration of orders from Atlas to GO, and the corresponding tickets have already been raised: GO#00300219, INC55600696 (1,200 GTP orders released orders with slowness between Atlas & GO system, they were visible 3 hours after release)
We request support to identify the root cause (RCA), define and implement the necessary corrective and preventive actions, and ensure this behavior does not recur during tomorrow’s scheduled release.
Please confirm the identified RCA, as well as the corrective and preventive actions that will be implemented to mitigate any risk to tomorrow’s release execution.
Thank you for your support and prompt follow-up.
Best regards,
Diana

cases.Description:
Hello Team, 

we need investigation on these scenarios and what messages are being sent from GM to scale when these occur:

 Suggested scenarios contributing to SCALE failed messages:	
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1:  rack is short Qty not found in other rack 9 labels scanned,  9 serials completed; 
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1:  rack is short Qty is found in other rack 9 labels scanned,  9 serials completed from first rack and last is completed from the last rack; 
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1: 10 labels scanned, but only 9 serials completed; user cancels the last case.
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases  WHERE CASE QTY IS 1: Only 9 labels and 9 serials scanned; user cancels the last case.
1	SKU serial tracking  WHERE CASE QTY IS >1: Two cases × 6 units; first case completes 6/6, second completes 5/6. scans after confimg KQ of 6/6
1	SKU non serial tracking  WHERE CASE QTY IS >1 : Two cases × 6 units; first case completes 6/6, second completes 5/6.

cases.Subject: Adjust all MSU Dimensions to be 2cm bigger
cases.subject: Adjust all MSU Dimensions to be 2cm bigger
cases.Description: We often have to induct boxes that are slightly too big to fit into a given space on an MSU, and it causes the put-calc algorithm to say there are no suitable spaces in the field for the box. If every space in MD would be about 2cm longer and wider, then we could squeeze boxes into the MSU's, and operationally nothing would be affected.

cases.Subject: Add count type field to audits table
cases.subject: Add count type field to audits table
cases.Description:
Hello GO team,
We need your support from the D&A Supply Chain Aritzia team to diagnose and implement a solution for adding a count type field to the audits table.
Issue

  *   Need a new field to capture count type. Currently dependent on naming logic which is non-standard and identifies only about 50% of count types

Impact

  *   Unable to classify all audits based on count types for analysis and reporting

Scope

  *   Table: audits

Request

  *
Introduce a new field count_type to capture the audit count type
  *   Align data ingestion/mapping to populate count_type for all audits
  *   Clarification on data model changes, migration steps, and validation approach
  *
A proposed plan with timeline

Thanks in advance!

cases.Subject: Differentiate AGV error reporting between Emergency Stop and WebSocket disconnection
cases.subject: Differentiate AGV error reporting between Emergency Stop and WebSocket disconnection
cases.Description:
Currently, AGVs report the same E-Stop status for both physical emergency stops and Safety WebSocket disconnections. 

We would like to evaluate the possibility of reporting different error codes or statuses for each scenario, allowing Operations and Robotics teams to identify the root cause and apply the appropriate recovery process more efficiently.

cases.Subject: Issue: Bot 6844 – Repeated Maintenance Mode (Server-Initiated)
cases.subject: Issue: Bot 6844 – Repeated Maintenance Mode (Server-Initiated)
cases.Description:
Hi Team,

Site: DHL Figs
Issue: Bot 6844 is repeatedly entering maintenance mode (true) due to a
server-initiated command. After manually disabling maintenance mode
(false), the bot resumes normal operations and charges automatically at the
station. However, it consistently returns to maintenance mode(true) after
approximately 5 to 8 hours.

Action Required: Please investigate the cause of these server-initiated
commands and apply the necessary corrective actions to prevent this from
recurring.

Best regards,
MTC DHLFIG

cases.Description:
GO and Operations,

 

GO and GXO IT will be performing Inventory sync and Maintenance on Wednesday October 28 from 10:00 PM – 1:00 AM CST, only if operations give clearance that they are ready for the sync ahead of schedule, the sync will begin earlier than the indicated start time if confirmed by Client Support.

 

Operations Pre-requisites:                                                                                                   

 

LOG OUT OFF ALL PPS STATIONS AND CLEAR ALL BINS BEFORE 09:00 PM CST (no pending pick, put or audit tasks).                                                                                                                                                                                

1.       Stop induction into GO at 08:00 PM CST.

2.       Start clearing the bins.

3.       If you run into an issue clearing the bins, please follow below process:

a.       Call help desk and open a code orange. (Make sure only one person from operations is calling help desk to open a code call to report issues related to all PPS stations (Pick and put PPS stations). Do not have multiple people call help desk from different areas.)

b.       If you do not receive a response from help desk with the code details within 15 mins, call again to follow up.

c.       Get GO support on the code orange.

d.       Do not sign off to close the call until all bins are cleared.

4.       Log out of WMX and GO by 08:30 PM CST.

 

We had to cancel maintenances in the past due to operations not able to meet the pre-requisites on time. This process will help ensure you get the help at the right time.

 

Maintenance will be coordinated by Client Support. A bridge line will be open at 10:00 PM CST and will require representation from Operations (optional) and GO.

Periodic email updates will be sent through the maintenance.

 

Below are the planned activities:

cases.Description:
Hello Security Team,

My name is Dnyanesh Chandanshiv, and I’m an independent cybersecurity
researcher working on vulnerability discovery, web application security,
and authorized security testing.

I recently identified a potential security weakness in your public-facing
environment that may warrant further investigation. I would welcome the
opportunity to provide a clear technical explanation, supporting evidence,
and remediation guidance through an appropriate channel.

I’m also interested in building long-term collaborations with organizations
that value proactive security testing. If your company offers a bug bounty
or vulnerability disclosure program, I’d be happy to follow the established
process. Alternatively, I’m available to discuss a *paid *private
penetration-testing engagement tailored to your security requirements.

Would you be available for a short discussion, or could you direct me to
the person responsible for security research partnerships?

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Dnyanesh Chandanshiv
Independent Cybersecurity Researcher
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dnyanesh7030

cases.subject: Sorter Machine Sensor Issue <> Grey Orange
cases.Description:
Hi GreyOrange Team,
This is to bring to your attention the ongoing issue with the sorter machine. As confirmed by Srinath, is related to a sensor malfunction.
We have been experiencing this issue for the past two days, and it is significantly impacting our shipment processing operations. Due to the sorter malfunction, we are facing difficulties in processing and dispatching shipments on time to meet the scheduled connections.
Additionally, we have observed that the sorter machine is incorrectly accepting Hold shipments, K-File shipments, and high-value shipments, which should not be routed through the sorter. This is a serious operational concern, as it may lead to shipment misrouting, processing delays and service-level breaches.
Considering the impact on daily operations and timely shipment movement, requesting the team to investigate the sensor issue on priority and resolve it as soon as possible. Pls also ensure that the sorter is functioning correctly and that restricted shipment categories are not being processed through the machine.
Pls treat this matter as urgent and your immediate support and intervention are highly appreciated.


Regards,
Deepak Gowda S

cases.Subject: RIL Robot Issues
cases.subject: RIL Robot Issues
cases.Description:
Grey Orange,

Today, someone called me to the production floor.  Shown below is the
picture below shows what was happening with the robots:

[image: image.png]

[image: image.png]

RIL8234:  Robot Blocked.  I took control of this robot and moved it out of
the way.

RIL8236:  I thought it was trying to pull into its parking spot but that
was not the case.  It was tasked to go to the other end.  After moving
8236, I brought 8234 back onto the highway and it continued with its task.

RIL8235: Robot has an error.  Please fix it.  I moved this robot one spot
and it continued reporting the same error.  Afterwards, I moved it back to
its home position and the error persisted.  I shut down and reset the
robot.  This seemed to solve the problem.

All of this occurred around 1:34 PM EST.


A little later RIL8233 was stuck outside the field trying to pick up an
empty MSU at station 13.  I thought the reflector issue was happening again
but after replacing the reflectors, the robot still would not go underneath
the MSU.  I checked the QR code underneath the MSU and it was fine.  The
robot would not allow me to take control, so I shut it off and restarted
it.  This seemed to solve the issue.

I'm not sure why I had to shut down the robots to get them back on task.
They were all shut down over the weekend (meaning Saturday through
Monday).

Thanks,

*Stephanie Ayres*

alerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
alerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
alerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

openAlerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
openAlerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
openAlerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

perform a Node-RED restart for RyderML. This activity is scheduled for

To maintain alignment between both parties until a permanent fix is in

priorities.

The bridge call has already been scheduled in the calendar for Saturdays at
the same time.

Link: meet.google.com/ceq-ihmg-gpm

Best regards,
Tyran Mcknight

allAlerts.Subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
allAlerts.subject: Prod Platform Core H&M Canada – Rapid Disk Utilization Due to Tomcat Log Growth
allAlerts.Description:
**Issue:**

While monitoring the disk utilization for **prod-platform-core – H&M Canada**, we observed continuous growth in the `/opt` partition due to rapid generation of Tomcat logs.

**Findings:**

* `/opt/tomcat/logs` was identified as the major contributor to disk utilization.
* At **10:30 AM**, Tomcat logs were approximately **126 GB**.
* Currently, Tomcat logs have increased to approximately **131 GB**, an increase of around **5 GB**.
* Total `/opt/tomcat` size increased from **133 GB to 137 GB**.
* Current `/opt` partition utilization is around **87%**.
* `catalina.out` is growing rapidly, with multiple rotated `catalina.out.*` files being generated.
* We observed repeated `NoClassDefFoundError` for `SubscriberPayloadValidator`, followed by HTTP 500 responses and retry attempts.
* Approximately **210 occurrences** of this error were observed in the current `catalina.out`.

**Actions Taken:**

* Performed first-level analysis of disk utilization and Tomcat log growth.
* Identified Tomcat logs as the primary contributor to the increasing disk usage.
* Checked `catalina.out` and rotated log files and identified rapid log generation.
* Identified the repeated `SubscriberPayloadValidator` error as a possible contributor to the excessive log generation.
* Aligned with **TAC, SRE, and Platform teams** for further investigation.
* Discussed with Platform team regarding the disk utilization threshold/configuration. As advised, we are currently monitoring the disk until it reaches **92%**.
* Platform team advised that there may be an existing configuration/action triggered above **90% disk utilization**, but the exact configuration is currently not confirmed.

**Current Status:**

* `/opt` disk utilization: **87%**
* Tomcat logs continue to increase.
* Further investigation is required to identify the root cause of the repeated application error and excessive `catalina.out` generation.
* Platform/TAC support may be required if disk utiliz...

closed.Subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.Description:
Ongoing issue, no timestamps available.

Our inbound team reported that shortly after the latest build upgrade they have experienced an issue with pre put tool where the system allows the creation of the LPN expectation without giving the weight limit breached alert and only gives the alert when they attempt to finalize and release the pallets.

This is not a desired functionality, as the weights might reflect different in the packaging vs. inventory parameters. The team needs to know if the system considers the attempted put task over weight limit before they physically move the goods on to the rack.

You can find an image attached describing the error message, please let us know if you need further on-site validation.

Best regards,

Antti

closed.Description:
Store has two Zebra label printers, one on the first floor and another on the ground floor. Both printers have stopped working. Standard troubleshooting steps have been completed. however, the issue persists with no improvement. There do not appear to be any issues with the printers or network connectivity, as both printers are showing as connected in the Meraki Portal.

Details Checked:
Verified printer connectivity in the Meraki Portal; both printers are connected.
Checked the printer hardware portal; 10300Zebra2 is showing "ERROR CONDITION PAPER OUT".
Verified the CUPS server; connectivity is confirmed for both Zebra printers.
Reviewed BI Publisher configuration; no discrepancies were identified.

Printer Information:
10300Zebra: 192.168.9.125
10300Zebra2: 192.168.9.124

As network connectivity, CUPS connectivity, and BI Publisher configurations appear to be functioning correctly, could you please verify the gStore printer configuration for these printers?

good.

vdastop

kubotrestart
vdastart

Hi GO Team,

We have identified an issue with the report export functionality in GO. When exporting reports to CSV format, the exported file does not contain the required field/column names (headers). As a result, it is difficult to identify and interpret the data in the exported report.

Issue Details:
Report exported from GO in CSV format.
Column headers/field names are missing in the exported file.
Data is present, but the absence of headers makes the report difficult to understand and process.

Impact:
Store users are unable to accurately identify the data fields.
Additional manual effort is required to map the data columns.
Reporting and analysis activities are impacted.

Request: Kindly investigate the issue and ensure that all required column names/field headers are included in the exported CSV files.

Regards,
Shanavas

closed.Description:
Hi,

We would like to request the permanent removal of barcode 001.011 from the Butler mapping

Barcode 001.011 must not be used as a travel path or parking position for any Butler, as Butler movement over or onto this location causes recurring issues

At present, we have had to create and position a fictitious Butler on barcode 001.011 in the system to prevent other Butlers from travelling over or parking on this location

This is only a workaround and means that we cannot use this Butler in normal operation

We do not require further support or troubleshooting for this issue

We have investigated and worked with this problem through support for several years, and the permanent solution we require is simply to remove/disable barcode 001.011 from the mapping, ensuring that it is excluded from all Butler routing

Once barcode 001.011 has been permanently removed from the mapping, we can remove the fictitious occupancy and return the Butler currently used for this purpose to normal operation

Please arrange for 001.011 to be permanently removed or blocked in the mapping/routing system

Thank you in advance.

closed.subject: Request for GO Roles, Profiles, and Permissions Documentation
closed.Description:
Hi @GO Service<mailto:service@greyorange.com> team,

As part of our ongoing GO Roles and Permissions review, we are looking to better understand the current security model and access controls within GO.

Could you please provide detailed documentation for the roles, profiles, and permissions currently available in GO, including:

  *   A list of all available roles that can be assigned to users.
  *   The purpose of each role and the intended user group.
  *   The specific permissions and capabilities associated with each role.
  *   Any relationship between Roles, Profiles, and Permissions, including how access is inherited or combined.
  *   The menus, dashboards, screens, modules, and functions that each role can access.
  *   Any system-defined or out-of-the-box roles (e.g., Warehouse Manager, Team Lead, Supervisor, etc.) and their corresponding access rights.
  *   Any roles that are obsolete, deprecated, or no longer recommended for use.

We have identified several roles that are available for user assignment, but the permissions and capabilities associated with those roles are not clearly documented or visible within the application. This information will help ensure our role definitions align with GO's intended security model and support our user access review.
Additionally, if there is existing documentation describing the GO security architecture and best practices for role assignment, we would appreciate receiving that as well.

closed.Subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.Description:
Opening on behalf of kprakash@aritzia.com and the ATZ team

Currently we are receiving a "takenoff" message for every single eComm
singles task picked into the same physical tote. 20 different orders picked
into a singles tote means 20 taken offs. Since there is only one tote
needing one move, 19 extra taken offs create unnecessary noise.

BY WMS only needs one. We are currently handling this through BY WMS by
ignoring / filtering taken off messages in a deferred queue.  This
enhancement request is to have GO not send extras in the first place.

Was a legacy request from E2E testing phase.

closed.Description:
Hi Team,

It has been reported that during remote testing of store CZ0042, which started on 16 Oct, multiple EPCs were found to have inconsistent location reporting between Keonn Cloud and GStore across zones CP2, SR3, and Z5-Z10.

The issue was initially reported directly to Keonn via email. Keonn's initial assessment was that the discrepancies could be related to a mismatch between the GStore and Keonn zone maps. However, after reviewing the mappings from reader stream, they could not identify any obvious mapping errors that would explain the behaviour.

Seems Keonn has subsequently contacted Yagna for further investigation, but after several days without any feedback or progress, the issue has been reported to Hypercare support, as testing has already been ongoing since 16 Oct.

Multiple EPCs are being reported in different locations in Keonn Cloud and GStore, indicating a potential location accuracy issue. A possible cause could be reader placement, configuration, mapping, or another underlying integration issue, but this has not yet been confirmed.

Examples and screenshots are attached. Additional EPC examples are available for all affected zones if required.

Request:
Please investigate the discrepancies between Keonn Cloud and GStore, verify zone mappings and reader placement/configuration, identify the root cause, and provide recommendations for resolution and next steps.

Regards,
Pradeep

Store ID: CH0927. 

The store reported the following: 

Hi,

We conducted several tests yesterday in CH0927 to investigate the behavior of item localization and ISR Pool updates following refill activities.
Similar behavior has been reported by multiple stores in Switzerland (CH), the Netherlands (NL), and Austria (AT).

Test Scenario
We processed multiple replenishment lists using both options:

"No, I'll put them myself"
"Yes, put using gStore"

The results were identical in both cases, although the Store Manager informed us that selecting "Yes, put using gStore" should normally result in a faster update.

Localization Results
After completing the lists, all items were physically moved to the sales floor.

When performing a HAS on the items, the localization behaved as expected:
Within approximately 45 minutes, the articles were correctly localized in the appropriate sales floor zone.
This was observed consistently regardless of which completion option was selected.

ISR Pool Behavior
The behavior of the ISR Pool differs significantly and does not appear to update in a timely manner.

Observed behavior:
Once the list is completed and the items are moved to the sales floor, the articles disappear from the ISR Pool for approximately 15-20 minutes.
They then reappear in the ISR Pool roughly 20 minutes later.
The articles remain visible in the ISR Pool for at least 1 hour and 30 minutes, despite already being physically present on the sales floor and correctly localized via HAS.
Only after this period does the ISR Pool finally update and reflect the correct situation.

Business Impact
As a result, stores are unable to reliably perform refill activities every hour, as the ISR Pool does not accurately reflect the actual stock situation on the sales floor and appears to be updated with a significant delay.

This creates uncertainty for store teams and may lead to unnecessary refill tasks, reduced operational efficiency, and lower confidence in the ISR Pool as ...

closed.Subject: gStore 2nd Line -Fulfillment  issue -INC7181319
closed.subject: gStore 2nd Line -Fulfillment  issue -INC7181319
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

Missing CREATED Fulfillment Events Causing False Alerts

Our investigation identified a data quality issue in the GreyOrange fulfillment event generation process. For certain fulfillments (for example, 70724249603 and 70724591843), the expected CREATED event is missing from the fulfillmentEvents.event history.

This creates an operational edge case where a fulfillment is created, but the first recorded event is generated only after a significant delay (more than one hour later), such as PRODUCTS_PICKED, READY_FOR_PICKUP, DELIVERED, or another downstream status.

During this period, monitoring has no event indicating that the fulfillment has reached the system, which results in false alerts and incident creation by the Production Assurance Unit.

While it may be suggested that the creation state can be derived from fulfillmentProgress.process_status = CREATED, this is not a reliable workaround. The fulfillmentProgress.process_status field and related fulfillment attributes are updated as the order progresses and do not retain historical status values. Therefore, the original CREATED status may no longer be available when the alert condition is evaluated.

Our analysis confirms that this is not a data ingestion or latency issue. The root cause appears to be the missing CREATED fulfillment event in the event history, which impacts monitoring accuracy and leads to false incident generation.

Can you please check on this 

Thanks,
 Ramamohan N

closed.subject: CN4044 store: The inventory of DBG items is incorrect after the cycle count - INC0949410
closed.Description:
Hi GO Team,

After the cycle count, the inventory for DBG items is showing incorrect quantities. We observed an inventory discrepancy caused by an adjustment that was posted in cycle count, resulting in incorrect inventory being reflected in SIM. 

UPC SKU Actually SIM
198605710025 DBG1167550:CHE:7 4 5
198605710001 DBG1167550:CHE:6 4 5
198605713156 DBG1169591:BLK:6 4 5
197634162867 DBG1147350:SAN:5 0 3
198605380686 DBG1158313:CHE:8 0 1
198605713163 DBG1169591:BLK:6.5 0 1
199727522732 DBG1175118:SRPF:5 1 2
199727522770 DBG1175118:SRPF:7 4 5
198605709982 DBG1167550:CHE:5 0 1

Could you please investigate and let us know: 
1. Why was the inventory adjustment posted when there were no inventory mismatches identified before the cycle count? 

2. Why was an adjustment generated after the cycle count, even though the physical count matched the system inventory? 

3. What caused this apparent false adjustment, which has led to an inventory discrepancy between SIM and the physical stock? 

Please let us know the RCA for why false adjustment getting posted after cycle count.

Regards,
Shanavas

closed.Description:
We have identified recurring elevated response times for pause and resume operations on Zone-301 at site BRSP04.
Observed requests:
- August 19, 23:36:47 — pause: 2.63 s
- August 22, 13:03:25 — resume: 3.4 s
- September 10, 08:49:49 — pause: 2.58 s
- September 17, 16:59:35 — pause: 4 s
Endpoints observed:
/sites/BR/warehouses/BRSP04/safety/zones/Zone-301/pause
/sites/BR/warehouses/BRSP04/safety/zones/Zone-301/resume
Based on the warehouse layout, Zone-301 is not the largest zone in the site; for example, Zone-401 appears to cover a larger operational area. However, we repeatedly observe higher response times when pause or resume actions are executed for Zone-301.
Could you please investigate whether there are factors beyond the physical size of the zone that could affect the processing time for Zone-301? In particular, we would like to understand whether its configuration, associated resources, active rules, operational status, or internal processing queues could be contributing to this behavior.
Please also let us know if you identify any relevant anomalies in the logs around the timestamps listed above.

Which HTTP requests are failing and where these requests are originating from.

The reasons for the HTTP request failures.

Why the API backups are not completing successfully.

Whether these failures are directly contributing to the plan failures.

Please share the detailed findings and root cause to help us confirm the correlation between these issues and the plan failures.
